title: Ask Jorah: what the phone says back

status.description: ok: the whole spoken part. partial: the deadline passed, the rest lands in the chat. busy: another question is running or too many were asked. unavailable: the Gateway couldn't be reached or failed. refused: bad token or bad request

say.description: The text the Shortcut speaks. Always present, never empty

in_app.description: More of the answer is in the chat (the iOS app or Telegram) than is spoken
